description_en: Exports the list of shared cloud computers to an XLSX file. Each record includes the shared cloud computer ID and name, office network ID and name, shared cloud computer template, security policy name, and other details
description_zh: 调用本接口导出的共享型云电脑列表将保存为XLSX文件。每条共享型云电脑数据包括共享型云电脑ID和名称、办公网络ID和名称、共享型云电脑模板、安全策略名称等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd export-desktop-group-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-4676710000 --desktop-group-name CloudComputerPool01 --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --policy-group-id pg-53iyi2aar0nd60000 --charge-type PrePaid --expired-time 2022-12-31T15:59Z --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --end-user-id alice --lang-type zh-CN --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExportDesktopGroupInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network to which the shared cloud computer belongs
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑所属的办公网络ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the shared cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.    

Maximum value: 100.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

最大值：100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more results exist
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the policy associated with the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑关联的策略ID
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑的计费方式
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the subscription shared cloud computer. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 包年包月共享型云电脑的到期时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601 标准（UTC 时间）
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en: The list of shared cloud computer IDs
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized user IDs for the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑的授权用户ID列表
parameters.name: end_user_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. This parameter cannot be an empty string if specified. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

Url.description_en:
The download URL of the exported shared cloud computer list file. The exported file contains the following details:

Shared cloud computer ID/name
Office network ID/name
Shared cloud computer template
CPU/memory
System cloud disk/data cloud disk
Security policy name
Number of currently authorized users
Billing method
Creation time
Expiration time
Url.description_zh:
共享型云电脑列表导出文件的下载地址。导出文件包含的共享型云电脑详细信息包括：

共享型云电脑ID/名称
办公网络ID/名称
共享型云电脑模板
CPU/内存
系统盘/数据盘
安全策略名称
当前授权用户数量
付费类型
创建时间
到期时间
